actions.needTeam: Create or join a team to take it

join.sent: Request sent to the team on this bench.

guests.removeBody: {name} will no longer be able to drive the consoles of {bench}.

release.title: Release bench {bench}?
release.body: Your team and your guests lose control of its consoles. Remember to back up your configurations first.

offer.title: Back up {bench}?
offer.body: The bench was just released. Do you want to back up the devices' configurations before someone else takes it?

lock.title: Lock bench {bench}
lock.intro: Nobody but admins will be able to open a console or run a job on this bench. The reason is shown to everyone.

unlock.title: Unlock bench {bench}?
unlock.body: Students will be able to take it and open its consoles again.

assign.title: Assign bench {bench}
assign.intro: The chosen team holds the bench at once, instead of whoever may have it. If that team held another bench, it is released.

history.title: History of bench {bench}
history.releaseIdle: Bench released automatically for lack of activity (team {team})

notify.accepted: You joined bench {bench}: {name} accepted your request.
notify.refused: Your request for bench {bench} was refused.
notify.released: Bench {bench} was released: your request is cancelled.
notify.removed: An admin removed you from bench {bench}.

warning.one: Bench {bench} is booked by team {team} in {count} minute: back up and release it.
warning.other: Bench {bench} is booked by team {team} in {count} minutes: back up and release it.

notify.slot: Your slot on bench {bench} starts (until {end}): you may take it.

refused.locked: Bench {bench} is locked ({reason}): only admins may open its consoles.
refused.taken: Bench {bench} is held by another team: ask to join it.

errors.no_team: You need a team: create or join one first.
errors.reserved: Team {team} has booked this bench right now.
errors.already_occupant: You already work on this bench.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests are waiting on this bench.
errors.not_member: Only the team that holds the bench may do that.
errors.member_of_holder: This person belongs to the team: remove them from the team instead.
errors.not_guest: This person is not a guest on the bench.
errors.not_occupant: Only the bench's occupants may do that.
errors.bad_reason: Give a reason (200 characters at most).
errors.bad_slot: A slot starts and ends on a quarter of an hour, and ends after it starts.
errors.slot_too_long: A slot lasts {hours} h at most.
errors.slot_too_far: Slots are booked at most {days} days ahead.
errors.slot_overlap: This slot overlaps the one of team {team}.
errors.too_many_slots: Your team already has {max} bookings ahead.
errors.not_your_reservation: Only the team that booked this slot may cancel it.
